facts.fact: TechReviewAfrica reports the Ghana Meteorological Agency received the PUMA-2025 and ClimSA stations under the EU-funded ClimSA project, giving access to Meteosat Third Generation data with images every 10 minutes, and that its staff were trained in forecasting and system administration.
facts.system: PUMA-2025 and ClimSA stations (Meteosat Third Generation)
